editor.label: Admin password
editor.description: Players type /AdminAccess <password> in the chat to become admin. Permanent admins: AdminList.txt. No double quotes or backslashes.

editor.label: Save name
editor.description: A new name starts a new world. Letters, digits, _ and - (64 at most).

editor.label: Search ID
editor.description: HumanitZ_Dedicated = the public server list. Any other value hides the server unless players search for that id. Letters, digits, _ and - (64 at most).

editor.label: Reserved slots
editor.description: Slots kept for the players in F_ReservedSlots.txt. Equal to the player count = whitelist server.

editor.label: Limited spawns
editor.description: Players only spawn at random coast spawns or their spawn point.

editor.label: Use the global ban list
editor.description: Rejects players banned from the official servers.

editor.label: Permadeath
editor.description: A player who dies loses the character.

items.text: Lose backpack and weapon in hand

editor.label: Player vs player
editor.description: Also allows using other players' cars and containers.

editor.label: Sleep skips time when everyone sleeps
Freeze time while the server is empty
Territory protection
editor.description: No building in someone else's spawn point area.

editor.label: Free build
editor.description: Off = some buildables need a foundation (experimental).

configFiles.description: Welcome message shown to players who join. Colors: <SP>ember</>, <PR>green</>, <PN>red</>, <CL>blue</>, <FO>gray</>
Permanent admins: one Steam ID (NetID) per line
Banned players: one Steam ID (NetID) per line
Players who get a reserved slot: one Steam ID (NetID) per line

script.name: RCON
script.description: Sends console commands to the server over its RCON port (HumanitZ answers every command with request id 0, which the standard Source RCON client does not accept).

script.name: Query
script.description: Server status from the RCON info command (name, players, season and time): HumanitZ answers no Steam query.

script.name: Save the world and shut down
script.description: Saves the world over RCON, asks the server to shut down and waits until it exits.

script.name: Prepare the server
script.description: Makes the server executable, copies steamclient.so to ~/.steam/sdk64 and installs missing shared libraries (apt, dnf or yum).
